scope: First verification batch, not complete language-model evaluation
exposure: Existing symbolic examples and proofs already inspected; constructed numerical diagnostics are development,not unseen scientific confirmation
primary_questions: Do implemented formulas agree with independent direct calculations?
Do original counterexamples and restricted positive cases occur numerically?
Does local protection survive state-dependent multi-step feedback?
Are total computation/storage savings supported when overhead is counted?

comparisons.data: Explicit constructed mathematical fixtures;not public benchmark samples
comparisons.conditions: Every R01-R20 latest source; FP64 dimensions kept small; separate seeds are diagnostic cases,not independent trained models
comparisons.outcome_rules: Pass numerical identity within stated tolerance; expected impossibility reproductions count as boundary tests; do not infer algorithmic superiority

comparisons.data: Declared deterministic2D feedback witness plus controlled finite-dimensional variations
comparisons.outcome_rules: Immediate zero and later positive damage refutes extension of a local-only certificate to long-horizon safety; does not refute every protected updater
Small-scale isolated timings only; no universal speedup claim or hardware extrapolation

statistics: Deterministic identities use numerical tolerances plus independent reference; stochastic cases expose seed and uncertainty; exploratory timings report paired raw repetitions,not significance
residual_required_coverage: Older candidate/control-specific checks flagged by coverage audit
